answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, diluted when peers disagree, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the cipher of a task receipt, and the ferrous is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the atlas of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
